statement: Warren 2026-10-16: a newer load replaces only the figures it carries. Units sold, on-hand, in-transit and on-order are superseded independently. A stock-only file never wipes sales; a sales-only file never wipes stock. Superseded figures stay in the superseded record with the superseding load; nothing is hard-deleted. Refines D-0090 (cross-grain supersession stays).
